parameters.query:
SELECT
 (SELECT json_agg(jsonb_build_object('substance',lower(substance),'severity',severity)) FROM allergen WHERE bot_id=$1 AND user_id=$2) AS allergens,
 (SELECT json_agg(jsonb_build_object('group_key',group_key,'title_ru',title_ru,'synonyms',synonyms)) FROM allergen_group) AS groups,
 (SELECT json_agg(jsonb_build_object('food_term',lower(food_term),'group_key',group_key)) FROM food_allergen) AS foods;
